page.overview:
Who is Jeffery Joal Annon?

Captain Jeffery Joal Annon was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century.

In 2364, he was the commander of the . Prior to stardate 41603.7, he received an order from Admiral Gregory Quinn of Starfleet Operational Support Services. (, okudagram)
